description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, set caps, and handle bus messages, for use within the Rialto server's Web Audio component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, set caps, and handle bus messages, used within the Rialto server's Web Audio subsystem.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a client and shared pointers to IGstWrapper and IGlibWrapper.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the Web Audio player.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop the Web Audio player.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start playback on the Web Audio player.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback on the Web Audio player.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a task to set the media caps (format, configuration) for Web Audio playback.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to signal end-of-stream for Web Audio playback.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the volume level for Web Audio playback.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a task to write audio buffer data to the Web Audio pipeline.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle bus messages from GStreamer related to Web Audio.
